key.name: run-in-background
key.description: Keep the app and Smart Layers running after the window is closed.

key.name: smart-layers-on-startup
key.description: Turn on automatic layer switching when the app starts.

key.name: notify-layer-changes
key.description: Show a desktop notification when Smart Layers switches the keyboard to another layer.

key.name: notify-excluded-layers
key.description: Layer indices that never cause a layer-change notification, such as a mouse layer the keyboard turns on by itself. Switches to them are silent, and while one is active the next switch is compared with the layer before it.

key.name: auto-connect
key.description: Connect to a supported keyboard as soon as it is plugged in.

key.name: show-in-tray
key.description: Show a tray icon and hide the window to the tray when it is closed, if the desktop has a tray.

key.name: heatmap-recording
key.description: Count key presses per key for the heatmap, also per focused app (window class only, never window titles). Only per-key counts are stored, never what is typed.

key.name: pair-recording
key.description: While the heatmap records, also count which key follows which within about a second, by key position, for the ergonomic score. Only pair counts per day are stored, never what is typed.

key.name: migrated-from-keymappforlinux
key.description: Whether settings were copied from the old KeyMapp for Linux path.

key.name: obsolete-keys-version
key.description: Internal: which cleanup of settings removed in earlier versions has run.

key.name: overlay-mode
key.description: When to show the layout overlay: never, while one of the selected layers is active, or always.

key.name: overlay-layers
key.description: Layer indices that show the overlay while active, when the overlay visibility is “selected”.

key.name: overlay-anchor
key.description: Screen edge or corner the overlay is anchored to.

key.name: overlay-size
key.description: Overlay size as a percentage of the keyboard's real size, so it looks the same on every monitor. 100 is life-size.

key.name: overlay-opacity
key.description: Overlay opacity in percent while no key is pressed.

key.name: overlay-fade-ms
key.description: How long the overlay takes to fade in, in milliseconds. Fading out takes three quarters of this. 0 shows and hides it at once.

key.name: overlay-half-spacing
key.description: How far apart the keyboard halves are drawn: 0 joins them, 100 puts them in the two corners of the anchored screen edge.

key.name: overlay-monitor
key.description: Connector name of the monitor that shows the overlay. Empty follows the focused monitor.

key.name: overlay-idle-seconds
key.description: Hide the overlay after this many seconds without key presses. 0 never hides it.

key.name: hold-pill
key.description: Briefly show a key's hold action on screen, such as Ctrl+C, when holding the key sends it. Needs gtk4-layer-shell, like the overlay.

key.name: hold-pill-excluded
key.description: Keys whose hold action is never shown, as "layer:key" with the layer position and the Oryx key index.

key.name: hold-pill-linger-ms
key.description: How long a hold action stays on screen after its key is released, in milliseconds, before it fades out. 0 hides it at once.

key.name: hold-pill-fade-ms
key.description: How long a hold action takes to fade in, in milliseconds. Fading out takes three quarters of this. 0 shows and hides it at once.

key.name: modifier-pill
key.description: While modifiers such as Ctrl are held, show them on screen with the last key pressed with them, such as Ctrl+Shift+T. Shift alone isn't shown. Needs gtk4-layer-shell, like the overlay.

key.name: modifier-pill-linger-ms
key.description: How long held modifiers stay on screen after the last one is released, in milliseconds, before they fade out. 0 hides them at once.

key.name: modifier-pill-fade-ms
key.description: How long held modifiers take to fade in, in milliseconds. Fading out takes three quarters of this. 0 shows and hides them at once.
